pages.title: Sugars
pages.text: Sugars include cake, cookies, honey, and other sweet foods.$(br2)Sugars have no default penalty for low intake, but contribute to the overall balance bonus when kept above 75%.$(br2)$(bold)Bonus (all groups above 75%):$()$(br2)$(li)Health Boost I$(li)Regeneration I$(br2)Sugars are easy to neglect — keep some honey bottles or cookies on hand.
